calculation_handling.description: Article 230.5.10 does not apply to a lawfully existing building that was not required to provide a bicycle parking space.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether the existing building was required to provide bicycle parking is an as-built fact we do not hold.

calculation_handling.description: Where the lawful number of bicycle parking spaces of a lawfully existing building is less than the required number, the lawful number is the minimum for that building.
calculation_handling.gaps: The lawful (as-built) number of bicycle parking spaces is not held.

calculation_handling.description: A lawfully existing building with fewer shower and change facilities than required keeps its lawful number as the minimum.
calculation_handling.gaps: There is no target for the number of shower and change facilities; the lawful number is an as-built fact we do not hold.

units.disclosure: For a lawfully existing building with fewer shower and change facilities than the by-law requires, the lawful number becomes the minimum. We do not model shower and change facilities or the as-built count, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension to a lawfully existing building must meet the bicycle parking space requirement or be authorized by a Section 45 minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether a proposal is an addition to a lawfully existing building is not lot data.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension to a lawfully existing building must meet the shower and change facility requirements or be authorized by a Section 45 minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether a proposal is an addition to a lawfully existing building is not lot data.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension to a lawfully existing building must meet the bicycle maintenance facility requirements or be authorized by a Section 45 minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether a proposal is an addition to a lawfully existing building is not lot data.

calculation_handling.description: On a change of use in a lawfully existing building, any additional required bicycle parking spaces must comply with Article 230.5.10 or be authorized by a Section 45 minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether a change of use occurs is not lot data.

calculation_handling.description: On a change of use, the number of lawful bicycle parking spaces of the lawfully existing building may not be reduced.
calculation_handling.gaps: The lawful (as-built) number of bicycle parking spaces is not held.

calculation_handling.description: On a change of use in a lawfully existing building, no additional shower and change facility is required.
calculation_handling.gaps: There is no target for shower and change facilities; whether a change of use occurs is not lot data.

units.disclosure: On a change of use in a lawfully existing building, no additional shower and change facility is required. We do not model shower and change facilities, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The lawful bicycle parking spaces of such a building need not meet the size, type and location rules in 230.5.1.10(4) to (6) and (9), and 230.5.1.10(3) does not apply.
calculation_handling.gaps: The as-built bicycle parking facts are not held.

calculation_handling.description: Regulation 230.5.1.10(12) does not apply to a lawfully existing building that was not required to provide bicycle maintenance facilities.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether the building was required to provide bicycle maintenance facilities is an as-built fact we do not hold.

calculation_handling.description: For Clause 230.5.10.11, lawful includes buildings, structures or uses authorized or permitted on or before March 31, 2025.
For Clause 230.5.10.11, lawful also includes buildings, structures or uses authorized after March 31, 2025 in accordance with Clauses 230.90.15.1 to 230.90.15.4.

230.5.10.11(1).explanation: The bicycle parking rules of Article 230.5.10 do not apply to a lawfully existing building that was not required to provide any bicycle parking space.

230.5.10.11(2).explanation: If a lawfully existing building that had to provide bicycle parking has fewer spaces than the rules now require, the number it lawfully has is its minimum.

230.5.10.11(3).explanation: If a lawfully existing building has fewer shower and change facilities than now required, the number it lawfully has is its minimum.

230.5.10.11(4).explanation: Any addition or extension to such a lawfully existing building must meet the bicycle parking, shower and change facility, and bicycle maintenance facility requirements, unless a Section 45 Planning Act minor variance authorizes otherwise.

230.5.10.11(5).explanation: On a change of use in such a building, additional required bicycle parking must comply with Article 230.5.10 or be authorized by a minor variance, the lawful number of bicycle parking spaces may not be reduced, and no additional shower and change facility is required.

230.5.10.11(6).explanation: The lawful bicycle parking spaces of such a building do not have to meet the size, type and location rules in 230.5.1.10(4) to (6) and (9), and 230.5.1.10(3) does not apply.

230.5.10.11(7).explanation: Regulation 230.5.1.10(12) on bicycle maintenance facilities does not apply to a lawfully existing building that was not required to provide them.

230.5.10.11(8).explanation: For this clause, lawful includes buildings, structures or uses permitted on or before March 31, 2025, and those authorized after that date under Clauses 230.90.15.1 to 230.90.15.4.
